'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[coordinate clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]]. This location is accessed by travelling to [[Mos Le'Harmless]] and either crossing the [[Stepping_Stone_(Mos_Le'Harmless,_level_82)|stepping stones]] (with 82 [[Agility]]) or through the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]]. Use of [[Protect from Melee]] or a [[Witchwood icon]] are needed to safely traverse the cave, along with a [[light source]] unless the [[Fire of Eternal Light]] has been built.
